observed_failure_sequence.limitation: These are actual past observations, never input as future outcomes in a replay. They do not isolate the cause of the whole-run loss.

rule_source.rule: After powered attack damage to the owner, generate the current amount of Dazed into the draw pile at random positions. Non-attack damage does not qualify. Counts remain conditional on all preview hits resolving with these targets/powers.

effects.scope: Native v0.111.0 Personal Hive; each qualifying hit adds the current stack amount, even when blocked. Non-attack damage does not trigger it. Counts assume these powers/targets and all preview hits remain applicable. Unknown hit counts, deaths, future modifiers, draws and random insertion order are not simulated. Base keywords can be affected by current rules.

sword_boomerang_card_flow.scope: Conditional additions only, separate from the unchanged observed piles. Not a next-hand prediction: planned draws, selections, discards, reshuffles and early termination are not simulated. Random insertion may change previously known top-card placement. Compare draw quality and future response availability as well as immediate damage.

replay.limitation: The two-plan result is close (end 0.52 / continue 0.48), not proof of reliable improvement, next-hand contents or a win. Existing actual-state Choice alone still nominated Sword Boomerang.

changes: Conditional pile additions shared by action and ordered-plan analysis
Native hit count first; strict unconditional live first-sentence fallback; unresolved repetition remains unknown
End-turn action nominations pass the same complete-plan comparison before dispatch
Older card generation history retained only when relevant to unresolved draw-order evidence

checks.scope: Card-flow, reaction, arithmetic, turn projection, history selection, context compiler and turn planning; accepted free draw and rejected extension preserve pre-dispatch memory.
